# BLE ACL Example

This is a BLE ACL example project for ACL peripheral and central roles. It demonstrates how to use the BLE API to implement a simple ACL connection between a central and a peripheral device.

## BLE ACL Peripheral Role

The peripheral role can read [BLE ACL peripheral role](../app_acl_peripheral/README.md)

## BLE ACL Central Role

The central role can read [BLE ACL central role](../app_acl_central/README.md)
